offering_description.value: Sells cloud file storage, sync, sharing and collaboration software to individuals, teams and businesses. Customers pay monthly or yearly subscriptions and use the service through web, desktop and mobile apps.

primary_products.value: cloud file storage; file sync and sharing; document collaboration; e-signature; AI-assisted search

primary_services.value: technical support; onboarding and migration help; enterprise administration support

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses and teams of all sizes, including enterprise customers; B2C: individual consumers and families

end_markets.value: technology; media and creative; professional services; education; financial services; healthcare

revenue_model.value: subscription: paid individual, family, team and enterprise plans

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and runs the cloud storage and collaboration platform, sold to individuals and businesses

geography_served.value: global: available worldwide, with large user bases in the US and international markets

specialization.value: related lines: cloud storage, file collaboration, e-signature and document tools sharing the same customers and platform

distribution_channels.value: online: self-serve sign-up through the website and apps; direct sales: enterprise sales team selling to large organizations; partners / resellers: channel partners and resellers serving business customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules such as GDPR and US state privacy laws covering customer files
